ueber_p1: The Förderverein of the Brandenburg State Orchestra Frankfurt (Oder) e. V. is the independent friends’ association of the BSOF. We support the orchestra where public funding falls short: with special projects, work with children and young people, and the orchestra’s presence within the local community.
ueber_p2: As a member, you’ll be part of a community that keeps orchestral culture alive in Frankfurt (Oder). You’ll gain a behind-the-scenes insight, priority access to tickets and invitations to exclusive events.
ueber_p3: Our motivation is simple: the belief that a symphony orchestra is part of the heartbeat of a city – and that together we can achieve more than we can on our own.
ziele_intro: In accordance with our Articles of Association, we promote art and culture, in particular BSOF as a significant cultural factor in the state of Brandenburg. We place particular emphasis on the cultural education of children and young people, as well as on links with Poland and Eastern Europe.
ziel1_text: We are committed to supporting the BSOF both politically and socially. As the only A-grade orchestra in the state of Brandenburg, it plays a significant role in cultural education within the state, but is also an indispensable part of life in Frankfurt (Oder) and the entire border region.
ziel2_text: We raise donations and funding from foundations and use them where public funding is insufficient – for projects that the orchestra would not be able to undertake on its own.
ziel3_titel: A focus on work with children and young people
ziel3_text: Music outreach and education for children and young people form the core of our work, as set out in our articles of association. We also support the development of particularly talented young artists.
ziel4_text: From open days to charity concerts – we provide organisational and financial support to the orchestra on special occasions.
ziel5_text: We organise or support our own small-scale concert formats – chamber music, recital-concerts, house concerts – where audiences can experience the musicians of BSOF in a special, intimate way.
ziel6_titel: The BSOF on display in the city centre
ziel6_text: Mini-concerts, street performances and collaborations with organisations in Frankfurt bring the orchestra to the public and also foster cultural ties with our Polish neighbours. Förderverein is on board!
gruss_p1: Dear music lovers and friends of the Brandenburg State Orchestra Frankfurt,
gruss_p2: It is no secret that the arts are in trouble. Our national orchestra knows this only too well. We have set out to find ways forward: to provide support, to help, and to drive change and lobby for the sector.
gruss_p3: What drives us? A passion for culture. For music. For OUR State Orchestra – and therefore for our city, Frankfurt (Oder). Will you help us?
gruss_p4: Förderverein thrives on people who get stuck in. People who don’t just listen, but help shape the organisation. Become part of this community – as a member, a donor or an active volunteer.
